jess: Heads-up: found a reproducible bundler + edge issue with the JS SDK. Minimal repro below for Vite and Rollup + edge preview. Works in Node but fails in dev edge with import shape and retries. Anyone on this? :wave:

paul: paste quick steps?

jess: repo: tiny TS vite app. package.json uses "type":"module" and depends on @redwood/inference. src/app.ts imports default and does new Redwood({ apiKey }).generate(). Node: ok. Vite dev (edge preview): runtime throws "TypeError: Redwood.default is not a constructor". Rollup build for cloud preview yields similar. webpack dev server seems ok.

toni: probably default vs named export mixup. What does dist/index.esm.js look like?

jess: ESM file exists but it was generated from CJS sources so it contains `exports.default = ...` style which confuses esbuild prebundle. Vite skipped prebundle in our environment so browser got the raw file.

paul: try `optimizeDeps.include = ['@redwood/inference']` in vite config as quick test.

jess: did that — import error goes away. But auth/retry still different: Node retries 3x with jitter, edge shows 2 immediate tries then 401.

toni: edge runtimes throw DOMException or return Response; our retry predicate only checks `err.code` or `res.status` from node-fetch. That explains the mismatch.

build-bot: CI job #781 failed: playground-vite e2e failed, reproduces error (automated).

paul: plan: 1) add normalizeFetchError util that maps edge/browser/node errors to { status, body, original } 2) update retry predicate to use normalized status 3) change ESM output to ensure an explicit `export default` wrapper and update exports map 4) add CI job that runs vite preview+playwright to catch regressions.

jess: I'll open PR for (1) and tests mocking Node fetch, browser fetch, and a worker DOMException. Toni can own (3). Paul will add CI test.
toni: short docs note for DX: until patch, Vite users add optimizeDeps.include or import the ESM file directly: `import('@redwood/inference/dist/index.esm.js')` and TS users may need `esModuleInterop`/`allowSyntheticDefaultImports` until we ship the typings fix.

jess: repro files attached in PR. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
